name: Sound Wizard (HTML)
description: An audio analyser and tone generator for the phone, fast enough to keep up with real sound. Sound level meter (A, C, flat); spectrogram with FFT sizes up to 32768; triggered oscilloscope; a tuner for guitar, bass, ukulele and strings that reads to a tenth of a cent; tone analysis that names the base note, chord and key; rhythm analysis with tempo, tap tempo, repetition rate and main frequencies; and a note or frequency generator (sine, triangle, square, saw). Installable, full screen, works offline; nothing is recorded or sent.
note: Made for the phone (iPhone and Android): tap to listen; the microphone needs the https address.
